data: For fiscal 2024, the year ended June 30, 2024, Microsoft reported diluted earnings per share of $11.80, up from $9.68 in fiscal 2023. That is an increase of about 21.9%, which Microsoft rounded to 22% in its annual report. Net income for fiscal 2024 was $88.1 billion ($88,136 million), up about 22% from $72.4 billion in fiscal 2023. These figures come from Microsoft's fiscal 2024 Form 10-K as I recall it; I did not retrieve the filing for this answer.
